title: Do I need to supply external conveyors and spray equipment for a through-feed mine-car axle furnace?
summary: A through-feed furnace proposal for mine-car axles dated 15 November 2020, retained in Suneng's records, includes high-temperature hangers, the furnace and controls. External transfer equipment and the spray-quenching area are buyer-supplied. The hangers connect to the external transfer mechanism by pins and have guiding supports and a travelling seal at the furnace roof. Review the complete operating route through the hangers, connections and roof passage. Supplying hangers with the furnace does not mean that all transport and quenching equipment is included.
